title: Pregnant Blend 3-Mix Trio #23 (가로 띠·물결 / 부채꼴·물결 / 세로 띠·매끈)
prompt:

Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 48% of the way down her figure from the top and about 79% of the way down her figure from the top. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both arms raised overhead framing her silhouette, belly and bust both fully displayed, confident direct gaze, her extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.
